name: REFC: model27's reference extension of a stock machine, CHORD with a shortcut and two hooks that count
description: The smallest package that extends a stock machine instead of adding one (notes/66 §3, step W2): it proves the builder's extensions before CHORD Tables uses them. On CHORD's tracks, RETRIG + SWEEP = Wavetable, 0 to 64, shown and saved in k 30 by the builder's shortcut layer; CHORD's call for its frames (0x400ab15e) and the screen's tick go through REFC's code, which counts and calls the stock functions. Nothing sounds or shows otherwise. Never offered to users.

uses.why: an extension of CHORD, machine 5: no machine of its own, no descriptor, nothing registered
k 30, which CHORD Tables will read (notes/66 §2.4); the shortcut layer shows and saves it, REFC does not read it
CHORD's update gets its two frames through this one call (notes/66 §1.1): counted, then the stock function with the same arguments
the screen's redraw, about 30 Hz: counted, then the getter it replaces; with SAMPLE, through the tick dispatcher

unchanged: CHORD's sound and every other track

emulation.tool: tools/emu/test_refchord.py (Unicorn, the OS's own code, notes/66 §12)
emulation.build: alone, with sampler before and after it, and with sampler and refmachine2
